summary: The PDF supports every participant count in the c002 form: S1 analyzes 844 unique people (p. 7, Table 2, with Table 3 and Tables 8-9 each summing to 844), the paper prints no count at assignment or by arm, the response exclusions (3,452 to 3,414) and model observation counts (3,271 and 2,618) are recorded correctly, and S2 has no participants. One caveat leaves the coding unchanged: the regression tables print observations, not people, and 11 participants lack a model covariate (p. 20, Table 9), so the models may hold fewer than 844 people, but at least 655 by arithmetic, so criterion 2 holds on S1 alone.
